- [LLOG.11.7] **A `logical` fact's justification does not cross a tier.** A
  `logical` fact published to another tier arrives as its schema name and slot
  values, and the receiving tier asserts it under its own declaration of that
  schema ([LTIE.9.4]). Truth maintenance is per-tier ([LTIE.4.6.2]): the
  receiving tier holds one fact per identity, justified by nothing in the
  publishing tier.
